For Lenders & Credit Funds

You hold the loan. We give you an operator's read on the asset behind it.

Independent operational assessment, turnaround feasibility, and interim leadership for lenders and credit funds exposed to maritime, transport, and logistics assets.

Independent. Operator-led. US & Europe.

The decision

The financials tell you something is wrong. Not whether it can be fixed.

When a maritime credit wobbles, you need an operator's judgment on the asset, not another spreadsheet, to decide what to do next.

The read informs the decision

Support, restructure, or push?

When the read says

Support

The business is fixable and management can hold it. Keep backing it, against clear operational milestones.

When the read says

Restructure

Fixable, but not as it stands. Reset terms, leadership, or the plan, with an operator to steady it.

When the read says

Push

The operating case does not hold. Better to exit than to fund the gap. We will say so plainly.

  • Grew EBITDA by more than 130% in 15 months as regional CEO of a global maritime services group, rebuilding a commercial pipeline from near zero to over $30M.
